about: Haque Law is a personal injury firm with a single office in Houston.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: HAQUE LAW PLLC holds an active franchise tax responsibility in Texas with the right to transact business, Secretary of State file 0803626079, chartered 2020-05-14, and 1 Google-verified location. Identified because the name is close and the address is one we verified
G3.source: Active Franchise Taxpayers, published daily as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 11 named attorneys published, and 6 more people in roles the firm states are not a lawyer's.

G6.evidence: 215 public client reviews and 6 years since the entity was chartered in 2020
